objective: Enforce 50s idle polling and 3s active polling across InstaBox fleet to guard Vercel Hobby 1M monthly invocation limit, adjust heartbeat degraded threshold to 150s, configure once-daily cron fallback in vercel.json, and establish 6-hour external cleanup via GitHub Actions.

rulesConsidered: Vercel Hobby serverless invocations must be conserved by enforcing >= 45s and <= 60s idle polling on bare-metal worker fleets.
Vercel Hobby multi-daily crons must be decoupled to external schedulers to prevent platform deployment rejections.
Fleet heartbeat degradation thresholds must maintain at least 3x the worker idle heartbeat interval to avoid state flapping.
Endpoints invoked by automated schedulers must enforce fail-closed token authorization.
No secrets, private keys, or tokens may be committed to repository history.

forensicFindings: 11 bare-metal workers polling at sub-15s intervals would exceed Vercel Hobby's 1M monthly function invocation limit (~1.9M to 6.3M calls/month).
Vercel Hobby rejects multi-daily cron expressions (such as 0 */6 * * *) during project deployment, enforcing a maximum frequency of once per day.
With 50s worker heartbeats, a 45s heartbeat degradation threshold on the control plane caused worker state flapping to DEGRADED between normal heartbeat cycles.
changes: Updated services/instabox-agent/agent.py: configured IDLE_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS=50.0, ACTIVE_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS=3.0, and HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS=50.0; updated main loop to sleep 50s when idle and 3s while active until queue drains.
Updated services/rendering-engine/worker_daemon.py: aligned IDLE_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS=50.0 and ACTIVE_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS=3.0 with fast loop recovery.

Updated apps/web/factoryos/core/compute/instabox/InstaBoxFleetRegistry.ts: increased HEARTBEAT_DEGRADED_THRESHOLD_MS to 150_000 (150s, 3x 50s interval) and HEARTBEAT_BLOCKED_THRESHOLD_MS to 300_000 (300s).
Updated apps/web/vercel.json: adjusted cron schedule to once-daily (0 2 * * *) to strictly comply with Vercel Hobby platform limits.
Updated apps/web/app/api/cron/cleanup/route.ts: added support for CRON_SECRET || INTERNAL_API_SECRET_KEY, fail-closed 500 when neither key is configured, and exported POST handler.
Created .github/workflows/vercel-cron.yml: external 6-hour cron workflow (cron: 13 */6 * * *) invoking /api/cron/cleanup with Bearer auth and cold-start retries.

Deployed updated agent.py to /opt/instabox-agent/agent.py across all 11 active nodes (box2..box8, box10..box13), restarted instabox-worker.service, and verified all 11 nodes reporting HEALTHY (box9 quarantined).
Updated services/rendering-engine/tests/test_instabox_agent_backoff.py and apps/web/factoryos/tests/instabox-render-provider.test.ts; verified all 3 pytest tests and 29 Vitest tests pass cleanly.

security.notes: Zero credentials committed. CRON_SECRET verified fail-closed.
